lede: The biggest policy action this week lands at Mountain Village Town Council on Thursday, where a first reading would move Housing Authority fees out of municipal code and into an annually adjustable fee schedule — a structural shift in how affordable housing costs get set. The San Miguel County Housing Code Update working group also meets Tuesday to dig into proposed changes designed to remove Land Use Code barriers to workforce housing. Layer in HARC taking a look at a potential demolition and rebuild of Rebekah Hall — the town-owned building where HARC itself meets — and it's a week where housing and land-use decisions deserve a close eye.
